title: M.Sc. Student in Computer Science
about: I am an M.Sc. student in Computer Science at VinUniversity (full scholarship) and a research assistant at R2Studio, advised by Asst. Prof. Dung D. Le. I received my B.Sc. in Mathematics and Informatics from Hanoi University of Science and Technology, advised by Dr. Ngoc Thang Tran.
My research focuses on LLM-based and agentic recommender systems, memory for LLM agents, and multi-objective optimization with Pareto set learning.
quote: “Whatever you are interested in and get excited about, that is what you should do.” — Michael Kosterlitz, Nobel Prize in Physics 2016

education.degree: M.Sc. in Computer Science — Full Scholarship

education.school: Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST)

points: Memory for LLM-based recommendation: collaborative memory mechanisms that capture cross-user signals for agentic LLM recommenders (AMEM4Rec), and a trainable latent memory that refines LLM semantics into collaborative signals (in preparation).
LLM-based recommendation: retrieval-augmented LLMs for cold-start users (KALM4Rec) and LLM prompting for news recommendation (WWW 2025, ECIR 2026).
Multi-objective optimization: Stein Variational Hypernetworks for Pareto set learning in expensive multi-objective optimization (AAAI 2025, ACM TIST).
